onboarding.title: Set up your organization
onboarding.subtitle: A few quick steps. You can skip any of them and come back later.
onboarding.payBody: Transfer {amount} and enter the reference of your transfer. Your plan starts when we confirm the payment; you keep your current plan until then.
onboarding.paymentPending: Payment submitted. We will confirm it shortly.
onboarding.inviteHint: Enter e-mail addresses, one per line. Each person gets an invitation to choose their password.
onboarding.twoFactorHint: Add a second step when you sign in, so a leaked password is not enough to get in.
